resale_co.name: Continued Certificate of Occupancy (Zoning Certificate)
resale_co.issued_by: Township of Nutley Code Enforcement Department
resale_co.lead_time: Inspection requests must be in writing (SDL Portal or request form) at least 24 hours in advance. Transfer of real estate inspections: Building/Zoning Monday to Friday 8:00am to 3:30pm; Fire/Zoning Monday, Wednesday and Thursday 11:00am to 3:00pm.
requirements: Safety inspection by Code Enforcement before the sale, conveyance or rental (not a home inspection)
No work done without permits; all open building permits closed through final inspections before the Zoning Certificate is issued
Working smoke detectors on each level, including basement and walk-up attic, and within 10 feet of each bedroom
Carbon monoxide detector in the common area outside bedrooms, within 10 feet of each bedroom, where there is a fuel burning appliance or attached garage
Relief valves on the water heater and boiler piped to within 6 inches of the floor
Sump pump (if present) discharging outside, not into the sanitary sewer or onto adjoining property
Handrails/guardrails for anything over four steps; stairs in good shape inside and out
Switch and outlet covers in place; electric panel with no openings; no exposed wires or open boxes
Attached garage with no holes in walls or ceilings; toilets and faucets working; hot water at least 110 degrees with hot on the left
Proper fit and venting of furnace/boiler and water heater to the chimney; metal or UL listed foil dryer vents; bathroom ventilation (window or mechanical vent)
No broken windows or glass, no illegal conversions or living areas, no other visible safety faults
House numbers 4 to 8 inches high, visible from the street
Compliance with zoning regulations for the area

fees.label: Certificate of Continued Occupancy filing fee, per dwelling unit up to a 3 family (stated in the 2018 rental change-of-occupancy notice; confirm it applies to sales)
fees.quote: A Certificate of Continued Occupancy application needs to be completed each time there is a change along with a filing fee of $75 per dwelling unit up to a 3 family and $35 per dwelling unit for a multi-family.

resale_co.how_to_apply: Apply to the Code Enforcement Department, 2nd floor of the Municipal Building, 1 Kennedy Drive (office hours Monday to Friday 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., closed 12:30 to 1:30). Since July 1, 2026 inspection requests must be in writing through the SDL Portal (Nutley) or the Township's inspection request form, at least 24 hours ahead. The smoke/CO certificate is a separate application to Nutley Fire Prevention.

evidence.quote: A Continued Certificate of Occupancy or “Zoning Certificate” is required on all resales, rentals, and/or changes or tenancy.

The Township of Nutley, Chapter 700, Article XVII Section 700-116, requires that a Certificate of Occupancy shall be applied for and issued prior to the sale, conveyance or rental of any property within the Township.
No Zoning Certificate will be issued until all open building permits are closed.
Inspection requests must now be in writing as per the New Jersey Administrative Code 5:23-2.18(c).

resale_co.notes: The Code Enforcement CO Requirements sheet (July 2025) says a Continued Certificate of Occupancy or Zoning Certificate is required on all resales and cites Code Section 700-116. The only published fee ($75 per dwelling unit up to a 3 family) comes from a 2018 information sheet in the section on rental changes of occupancy, so confirm the current resale fee. The 2018 sheet names David Berry as Construction Official; no current named contact was found on the Code Enforcement page, so contact_name is left blank. The Zoning Officer phone on the CO sheet is 973-284-4957. The CO sheet's smoke and CO detector items overlap with the separate fire certificate.

requirements: UL approved smoke detectors on every level (excluding crawl spaces and unfinished attics with pull-down stairs), on the ceiling and within 10 feet of every bedroom, or within 10 feet of the stairway on levels without bedrooms
All battery smoke detectors must be 10-year sealed battery type; all existing hardwired systems must be maintained
Carbon monoxide alarms (UL 2034, dated) within 10 feet of all sleeping areas, with more on each floor that has sleeping areas
Homes with secondary power sources need a printed label (such as CAUTION: MULTIPLE SOURCES OF POWER) within 18 inches of the main electrical panel and electric meter (P.L.2025, c.19)
Homes with a monitored central station fire alarm must have it tested beforehand by a Division of Fire Safety certified company and give the test record to the inspector
Incomplete items at inspection mean automatic failure and a re-inspection; no specific inspection times are given

authorities.name: Nutley Fire Department, Fire Prevention Bureau (Department of Public Safety)
authorities.lead_time: Fee depends on how many business days before the inspection date the application is received: more than 10 business days for the lowest fee.

fees.label: Smoke detector and CO certificate, application received more than 10 business days before inspection
fees.quote: An application received more than 10 business days from date of inspection: $45

fees.label: Application received 4 to 10 business days before inspection
fees.quote: An application received from 4 to 10 business days from date of inspection: $90

fees.label: Application received fewer than 4 business days before inspection
fees.quote: An application received fewer than 4 business days from date of inspection: $161

authorities.how_to_apply: Fill out the Residential Certificate of Smoke Detector and Carbon Monoxide Compliance Application (owner/seller and agent details, block and lot, sale or rental) and submit it with the fee payable to the Nutley Fire Department, 228 Chestnut Street. Read all four pages; the inspection must pass before the certificate is issued.

evidence.quote: before any residential dwelling is leased, sold, or subject to change in occupancy for residential purposes, the owner shall obtain a certificate of compliance from Nutley Fire Prevention.
I UNDERSTAND NO SPECIFIC INSPECTION TIMES WILL BE GIVEN.
NOTE: ALL battery-operated detectors must be a 10-year sealed battery type.
Nutley Fire Inspectors WILL NOT test central station fire alarms.
LEAID: 0716-001 Nutley Twp ... Fire Official Paul Cafone Phone (973) 284-4937 ... Email pcafone@nutleynj.org

fire_cert.notes: The February 2026 application is already updated for P.L.2025, c.19: it adds the secondary power source label and does not list a fire extinguisher. The form header lists Chief Paul Cafone at (973) 284-4936; the state directory lists him as Fire Official at (973) 284-4937 with pcafone@nutleynj.org. No Fire Prevention web page was found on the Township site, so department_url is blank. The Code Enforcement page shows Fire/Zoning transfer-of-real-estate inspections on Monday, Wednesday and Thursday, 11:00am to 3:00pm.

other_items.label: Final water reading
other_items.detail: Contact the Water Department at (973) 284-4962, schedule online, or email waterbilling@nutleynj.org at least 24 hours in advance to schedule a final water reading.

other_items.label: Open building permits
other_items.detail: All open building permits must be closed by scheduling final inspections before the Zoning Certificate is issued.

other_items.label: Sump pump discharge
other_items.detail: A sump pump must discharge outside the structure, not into the sanitary sewer or onto adjoining property; checked at the CO inspection.
